correctness.rationale: The exact four-pair NFA determinization table, sixteen state reaching words and four singleton-distinguishing suffixes reconstruct the minimal automaton. The 8->8 zero loop with forbidden 11 exit and legal prefix/suffix give an infinite minimal forbidden family. Exact fifteen-state matrix identities prove the full rational generating function; positivity of its ninth power and Perron theory give spatial entropy. verify.py reconstructs each nonstandard finite identity and compares direct image blocks independently through length 12. Boundary n=0 and bilateral extension are handled in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: For a classical complex rule, the one-step image is a canonical global symbolic factor distinct from the dynamics on selected invariant subsystems. A full sixteen-state minimal DFA (attaining the four-state powerset maximum), rigorous infinite minimal-obstruction family, and exact all-length word-growth/entropy determine substantial natural invariants. These are not a small arbitrary finite census, a routine numeric substitution, or an unsupported downstream claim.
